title: The Dikko Affair revolves around the attempted kidnapping of Alhaji Umaru Dikko, a former Nigerian Minister, in London. Dikko was seized shortly after leaving his residence for an appointment with journalist Elisabeth Ohene. Quick actions by his personal secretary, Elisabeth Hayes, and the police led to a swift response from Scotland Yard's anti-terrorist unit. The kidnappers aimed to transport Dikko out of the country using a Nigeria Airways plane, but their plan was thwarted when customs officials detected suspicious crates containing Dikko and others. The incident raised significant concerns about diplomatic immunity and security protocols in the UK.
